meta.title: Relative Color Perception
meta.subTitle: Relative Color Perception
meta.desc: Master color vector constancy and Albers simultaneous contrast in OKLab perceptual color space.

rel_vector_shift.title: Color Vector Shift
rel_vector_shift.desc: Observe color vector shift A->B and select matching parallel shift C->D.
rel_vector_shift.instruction: Observe vector A->B and find matching vector C->D below.

rel_lightness_induction.title: Lightness Induction
rel_lightness_induction.desc: Compensate for background illusion to achieve perceived lightness constancy.
rel_lightness_induction.instruction: Adjust right center value so both center squares appear perceptually identical.

rel_hue_induction.title: Hue Induction & Harmony
rel_hue_induction.desc: Select the compensated target color to counteract chromatic induction (4AFC).
rel_hue_induction.instruction: Select the hue that compensates for the colored background (Keys 1-4).

rel_decontextual_2afc.title: Decontextualized 2AFC
rel_decontextual_2afc.desc: Pierce through simultaneous contrast illusions to identify the objectively brighter color.
rel_decontextual_2afc.instruction: Identify which center square is physically brighter (Keys 1 / 2).

views.vectorPrompt: Observe vector shift A➔B and pick the matching C➔D shift below
views.lightnessHint: Adjust right center lightness until both center swatches appear identical
views.inductionHint: Modulate right center color to counter background induction
views.hueSelectHint: Observe reference and preview candidate compensations below (Keys 1-4, Space)
views.decontextualHint: Pierce background illusion and identify the objectively brighter center square
